description: Enforced field set, enums, lifecycle transitions, and forbidden raw-content fields for an append-only RFC/Decision Protocol event. Single source read by scripts/validate_decision_protocol.py; the prose decision-protocol-event.schema.md describes intent and rules and does not restate these lists. Procedural checks (first event is DRAFT, cross-field requirements per state, reviewer independence) stay in the validator; only the declarative data lives here.
